$comment: Documented exceptions for the npm audit gate (scripts/security/npm-audit-gate.js). Each entry MUST include a justification. Only advisories with no upstream fix may be listed here.

allowlist.title: SheetJS Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
allowlist.justification: No upstream fix available (SheetJS ceased publishing fixed versions to the public npm registry; advisory affects all published versions). xlsx is only used to parse spreadsheet files uploaded by authenticated users in an authenticated server-side context, not on untrusted public input, so ReDoS exposure is limited. Replacement with an actively maintained spreadsheet library is tracked as follow-up work.

allowlist.title: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
allowlist.justification: No react-router-dom 7.x release is currently available outside the affected range while remaining API-compatible; 7.18.1 is the latest 7.x patch and the application does not use RSC/server-action features. The exception will be removed once a patched 7.x release or validated major upgrade path is available.

allowlist.title: brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
allowlist.justification: No patched releases exist for the minimatch@3 / minimatch@5 lines that still satisfy the transitive constraints of glob@7-based dependencies used by the server runtime (e.g., sequelize-typescript, yamljs, mjml). Upgrading those dependencies would require breaking API changes. The application does not expose brace-expansion to untrusted user input, so practical DoS exposure is limited. We will revisit once upstream releases compatible patched versions.

allowlist.title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
allowlist.justification: The advisory affects all published versions of image-size. The library is only used transitively by @mastra/memory for parsing image metadata, and the application does not pass untrusted image data to it directly. We will revisit once a patched version is released.

allowlist.title: image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
allowlist.justification: The advisory affects all published versions of image-size. The library is only used transitively by @mastra/memory for parsing image metadata, and the application does not pass untrusted image data to it directly. We will revisit once a patched version is released.
